description: Validates an address against the Aptos address standard (AIP-40) and returns its canonical form: special addresses (0x0-0xf) as short form, all others as 0x + 64 digits. Strict by default; mode=relaxed also accepts a missing 0x or a few dropped leading zeros, and says which spelling you used (a truncated-looking address is always refused). With lookup=true it checks the chain to say whether the address is an account, an object, or neither, at one ledger version.

chain.description: Aptos CAIP-2 id: aptos:1 (mainnet, default) or aptos:2 (testnet)

name: aptos_address_validate
title: Validate an Aptos address
